evidence.reason: The finding correctly identifies an internal documentation inconsistency. The README at lines 107-110 states that the frozen `RunEarlyStopReason` only contains `'budget'`, but the same README's governor section (lines 209-211) says a `signal` trip makes the report claim `earlyStopReason: 'signal'`.
